skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Grasp basic knowledge about public organizations and public organization management.

Apply knowledge about public organizations, their functions, and public organization management to analyze, evaluate, and solve practical problems in managing public organizations in changing environments.
Possess skills to manage public organizations through processes such as planning, organizing, leading, and controlling.
Possess skills to present issues convincingly.
Possess skills to work in teams effectively, organize and manage team work efficiently, assess the quality of work after completion and the performance of team members.
Possess good time and resource management skills.
Possess the ability to work independently or in groups under changing conditions; have the ability to evaluate and improve the efficiency of activities.
Have the ability to guide, supervise others to perform assigned tasks; take personal responsibility and responsibility for the group.
Have the ability to identify, solve problems in practical public administration management and protect personal views.
Have a spirit of service, social responsibility, and professional ethics.
Have the ability to self-study to meet job requirements and adapt to changes.
